change: Best grades: each foe keeps its best grade on the map, and an all-S realm is crowned

mutations.name: a worse win lowers the best
mutations.find: keep(had, l){ const b=this.best(had); return b && this.RANK[b]>=this.RANK[l] ? b : l; },

mutations.name: an old clear reads as a grade
mutations.find: best(v){ return typeof v==='string' && v in this.RANK ? v : null; },
mutations.replace: best(v){ return v===true ? 'C' : typeof v==='string' && v in this.RANK ? v : null; },

mutations.name: a new best is never said
one S crowns a realm
mutations.find: crowned(cleared, ri, n){ for(let fi=0; fi<n; fi++) if(this.best((cleared||{})[ri+':'+fi])!=='S') return false; return n>0; },
mutations.replace: crowned(cleared, ri, n){ for(let fi=0; fi<n; fi++) if(this.best((cleared||{})[ri+':'+fi])==='S') return n>0; return false; },

mutations.name: the card leaves out the best
a crown is celebrated every win
